title: Incretin Mimetic Modulation of Mesolimbic Reward and Substance Use
pre_discovery_prompt: Patients treated for glycemic control with gut peptide mimetics spontaneously report decreased alcohol, nicotine, and compulsive reward-seeking behaviors. What central neurological mechanisms explain this?
ground_truth_finding: GLP-1 receptors in the ventral tegmental area and nucleus accumbens attenuate dopamine release and mesolimbic reward pathway signaling.
notes_on_reconstruction: Stripped drug trade names (Ozempic/Wegovy/Semaglutide) and specific study titles.
